visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a grey sleeveless top, sits behind a white desk. She smiles and talks to the camera while gesturing toward a large rectangular cardboard box featuring cartoon beaver characters (Loopy). The background consists of a white bookshelf filled with various books and decorative items under bright indoor lighting. (2) She opens the cardboard box by lifting the top flaps. She reaches inside and pulls out a yellow bag of Lay's potato chips, showing it to the camera, then pulls out a second identical bag. (3) She places the bags on the desk and pulls out a smaller pink square box. She also pulls out more bags of chips with green and orange packaging, placing them on the table. (4) She opens the small pink box and takes out a ceramic mug wrapped in protective bubble wrap. She unwraps it to reveal a pink mug with a Loopy illustration, holding it close to the camera. (5) She puts down the pink mug and holds up a blue mug with a different Loopy illustration. She holds both mugs side-by-side near the camera, rotating them slightly to show the design. (6) She holds a yellow chip bag in one hand and gestures towards the mugs on the table while looking at the camera, concluding her presentation with a smile.
